responsibility: Implements the D front end’s ABI-oriented decomposition of types into register-passable argument and return components. Its central `toArgTypes(Type*)` visitor classifies basic, pointer, array, vector, class, enum, and especially POD struct types into a `TypeTuple` describing the one or two machine-level pieces that may be passed or returned in registers, or an empty tuple when the value must use memory/stack passing. The file therefore owns the front-end side of target-sensitive aggregate argument classification, including 32-bit versus 64-bit behavior, field-offset and alignment checks, and merging of subfield types into 8-byte chunks for small-struct calling-convention decisions consumed by later semantic/ABI lowering code.
